meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic tradition); codified commercial law under the Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971); special company regime under Ley 1258 de 2008 for Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas (S.A.S.); binding jurisprudencia of the Corte Constitucional and Corte Suprema de Justicia.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 15 May 2012)
Colombia-United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2010, in force)
Colombia-Spain Bilateral Investment Treaty and Double Taxation Agreement (DTA in force 2007)
Colombia-South Korea Double Taxation Agreement (in force 2014)
Colombia-Canada Double Taxation Agreement and Free Trade Agreement (DTA in force 2012)
Alianza del Pacífico Framework Agreement (in force 20 July 2015)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110 and 471 et seq.; Ley 526 de 1999 and Ley 1121 de 2006 (UIAF creation and AML/CFT regulatory network); Decreto Único Reglamentario 1067 de 2015 (PEP and information-sharing mandates); Ley 2155 de 2021 (DIAN-directed UBO reporting); Decreto 1736 de 2022 and DIAN Resolución 164 de 2022 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales implementation, statutory ownership threshold 5% of capital or voting rights); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Externa 100-000003 de 2023 (SAGRILAFT, beneficial owner, PEP and sanctions screening); Ley 1762 de 2015 (money laundering offenses and corporate liability); Ley 1581 de 2012 (personal data protection for KYC records).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - UBO reports are filed exclusively with the DIAN through the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales and are shared only with the UIAF, financial intelligence authorities, Superintendencia de Sociedades and judicial authorities upon lawful request; no public register access is available.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted by each non-resident shareholder for the incorporation of the Colombian S.A.S.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention de La Haye of 5 October 1961) or Colombian consular legalization for non-Hague member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent corporate authority of the shareholder's home jurisdiction (e.g., Secretary of State, Companies House)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board or Shareholders' Resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder expressly authorizing the creation of the Colombian S.A.S., the apportionment of quota capital and the appointment of local representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate board or company secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarially certified copies of valid passports and proof of residential address of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the origin jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Tax residency certificates of foreign shareholders and completed UBO self-declaration questionnaire (Formato de Beneficiario Final)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home tax authority (e.g., IRS Form 6166 for US persons) and each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization for the governmental certifications; notarized signature for the self-declaration

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Official Spanish translation of all non-Spanish documents by a certified translator registered in Colombia (traductor oficial)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator (Traductor Oficial) accredited by the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Translation is affixed to the apostilled/legalized original and further notarized before a Colombian Notary

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of each UBO, shareholder and legal representative against: (1) the UIAF PEP list and the Colombian official political exposure lists; (2) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (3) OFAC SDN List; (4) EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists; (5) Colombian in-country restricted lists (Listas de personas inhabilitadas, SIC and Fiscalía records); and (6) adverse media sources under the SAGRILAFT methodology. Screening must be completed before filing the incorporation documents, evidence retained for at least five years, and refreshed annually or upon any ownership change. Given ISIC 8220 (data labeling and AI training BPO) is classified as Low_Risk_Standard, enhanced measures (source-of-funds verification) are triggered only for non-resident UBOs domiciled in high-risk jurisdictions or where a nominee structure is detected.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Cámara de Comercio of the registered city operating through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) - https://www.rues.org.co (jointly administered by Confecámaras and the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be legible in Spanish script and transliterated to the Latin alphabet; foreign words are permitted where readably adapted to Spanish orthography. The name must comply with the principles of truthfulness and veracity (Principio de Veracidad) under Decreto 1074 de 2015 and must include or be followed by the token 'S.A.S.' unless a special denomination is requested. Names likely to mislead as to nationality, public character, regulated activity or association with the Colombian government are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a reconsideration request (recurso de reposición) with the same Cámara de Comercio within ten working days of notification, pursuant to Articles 74-77 of Ley 1437 de 2011. If the chamber maintains the refusal, an appeal (recurso de apelación) may be lodged before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within five working days. Alternatively, the applicant may submit a modified name for new reservation. Tokens such as 'Colombia', 'Nacional' or financial and insurance terms require the applicant to present the prior authorization of the competent supervisory authority (SIC, Superintendencia Financiera, MinCIT) at the reservation stage.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Colombian Commercial Code (Decree 410 of 1971), Articles 373-391; Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-46; Decree 2636 of 2012; Cámara de Comercio registration rules
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Regional Chambers of Commerce (Merchant Registry Office)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Instrument) filed via the Single Registry of Beneficiaries and Commercial Registration System
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum capital; share capital freely set in bylaws, expressed in Colombian pesos. Capital may be subscribed with payment terms of up to two (2) years for cash contributions; no escrow requirement or capital depository certificate mandated under Law 1258/2008.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. RESOLVED: 1) The subscription of the nominative share capital, as stated in Article Fifth of the Bylaws, is ratified and the corresponding share subscription certificate is issued to the sole shareholder; 2) The statutory seat and registered office are fixed at [Address], Bogotá D.C., with legal domicile duly recorded in the Chamber of Commerce register; 3) [Full Name] is appointed Legal Representative with broad corporate powers, and [Full Name] is appointed Substitute Representative; 4) The Representatives are authorized to obtain the NIT, open bank accounts, sign agreements, and engage personnel. Approved by the Sole Shareholder on [Date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (online portal: www.ccb.org.co / Virtual Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names for a homologation search; upon approval, reserve the exclusive name with a Certificado de Reserva de Nombre. The reservation is valid for 90 days and may be renewed once. If rejected, refile with alternative denominations or appeal via the registry's key accounts channel.
required_dossiers: Tax identification number of each subscriber (foreign passports accepted)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If names are identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity, the registry will request alternative names; cure by direct online resubmission within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Private Incorporation Instrument (if required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cryptic Notary (Notaría) only if real property contributions are made; otherwise private document signed by parties
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing company name, domicile, corporate purpose (AI data labeling, BPO, content annotation), capital, share classes and voting rights, legal representative appointment, clauses on data privacy and conflict resolution. Execute signatures; if contributions include real estate, notarize before a Notario Público.
required_dossiers: RUT draft (Registro Único Tributario) if available
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial objections corrected by re-signing the instrument; legalization of foreign signatures via consular apostille must be regularized before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - Commercial Registry Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation instrument, appointment acts, and registration forms through the registry's online system. Pay the registration fee (tariff based on subscribed capital), acquire the company's RUT category, and obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal which serves as definitive proof of incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a requerimiento (deficiency notice) is issued, correct within 30 calendar days via the same e-filing channel; failure requires re-filing; any refusal may be appealed via recurso de reposición (reconsideration) within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and NIT Activation (RUT + Invoicing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After commercial registration, apply for and finalize the NIT via the DIAN online portal (proceso de inscripción RUT). Select the economic activity codes (ISIC 8220, associated with data processing), determine if subject to VAT (services generally 19%, B2B exports may be zero-rated), and request authorization of electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica).
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation (issued by Chamber of Commerce)
Information on economic activities and estimated revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If submitted with errors, DIAN will return a rejection notice; corrections and re-submission of the RUT within 5 business days typically resolves; appeal via the DIAN 'Solicitudes' platform.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration with Social Security System and Parafiscal Funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administradoras de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), EPS, Caja de Compensación Familiar (e.g., Colsubsidio)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register as an employer before the social security system, select an ARL (occupational risk insurer) appropriate to an office/data operations workforce, register employees for health (EPS), pension (AFP), and labor risk coverage, and enroll in the Family Compensation Fund. Register work contracts in the SISTEMA de Gestión de Empleo.
required_dossiers: Lease or tenancy agreement of registered office
Valid e-mail and electronic registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registration omissions must be rectified through the ARL and employer portal before payroll runs; non-registration triggers fines under Decree 1072/2015 which must be resolved with the Ministry of Labor.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Data Protection Registry and Post-Incorporation Governance Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) and the Cámara de Comercio (for annual renewal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the BPO/AI data labeling activity processes personal data, file the privacy data-base registration with the SIC (Registro Nacional de Bases de Datos) under Law 1581 of 2012 and Regulatory Decree 1377 of 2013. Submit the privacy policy and data processing procedures in Spanish. Concurrently, hold the first shareholders' meeting minute that ratifies officers and the registered office address, and record any updates with the Chamber of Commerce.
required_dossiers: Privacy notice and internal data processing policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: SIC queries for incomplete descriptions of the data processing purposes: provide supplements within 15 business days; camera de comercio registration updates can be corrected via ordinary rectification procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - office-based BPO/AI data labeling (ISIC 8220) is a service activity exempt from industrial manufacturing licenses; only standard municipal commercial operation permits may apply.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required as a statutory license; general conformity obtained through the Chamber of Commerce commercial registration and the municipal 'uso de suelo' / zoning certificate for the office location.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente (Bogotá) / CAR; national oversight by the Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) only if industrial facilities existed - not triggered here
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - low-impact office/computing operation; no EIA or environmental license required under Decree 1076 of 2015, as the activity does not fall within annexes listing projects requiring licensing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater must comply with Resolution 631 of 2015 limits for discharge to municipal sewers; electronic waste (computers, labeling devices) must follow Resolution 1512 of 2010 take-back schemes. No industrial VOC or process emissions; HVAC and standby generators subject to emission limits per Resolution 909 of 2008.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Certificado de Bomberos) obtained annually from the local fire department, commercial occupancy structural load verification per National Building Code (Ley 400/1997), and occupational health and safety system (SG-SST - Resolución 0312 de 2019) covering the workforce with workplace risk assessment, emergency plan, and employee medical certificates.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (National Tax and Customs Directorate); official portal: www.dian.gov.co; digital transactional platform: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: STEP 1: Incorporate the S.A.S. before the Cámara de Comercio and obtain the 'Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal'. STEP 2: Appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia with an electronic signature; such representative submits the 'Pre-RUT' (Formulario R-001) to DIAN. STEP 3: DIAN issues the permanent NIT and the 'Certificado de Inscripción del Registro Único Tributario (RUT)', which simultaneously classifies the entity for income tax, VAT (Responsable de IVA - Régimen Común), electronic invoicing, and export status. STEP 4: Non-resident shareholders must evidence beneficial ownership and maintain a local 'apoderado' for service of process; in-kind contributions (software, IP, hardware) must be recorded in the articles of association. STEP 5: For service exports, activate the 'Exportador de Servicios' characteristic in MUISCA and register the company with the Foreign Trade Single Window (VUCE); foreign exchange receipts must be channeled through an authorized Colombian intermediary (bank) with a corresponding 'Declaración de Cambio'. All NIT-related filings are performed and acknowledged online through MUISCA; no physical presence is required beyond the legal representative's local address.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A Colombian S.A.S. is a resident juridical person taxed at the entity level; it is not eligible for pass-through/flow-through treatment (Colombian law has no check-the-box mechanism for S.A.S. entities). The entity files the 'Impuesto sobre la Renta y Complementarios' at the 35% corporate rate (FY 2025) on worldwide income; distributed dividends to non-resident shareholders are subject to the 10% remittance/withholding tax. For indirect tax purposes, the default classification is 'Responsable de IVA' (ordinary VAT taxpayer), which is required to claim input VAT credits and refunds on zero-rated exported services; Colombia applies a unitary national taxation system with no sub-national tax distinctions for income tax purposes, while municipal levies such as ICA in Bogotá are outside the national tax identity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not provide U.S.-style check-the-box elections or a statutory hybrid mismatch election for S.A.S. entities. Available elections relevant to this BPO exporter include: (i) 'Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE)' – optional consolidated regime covering income tax, VAT simplification and national consumption tax, available when gross annual income is below 100,000 UVT (approx. COP 4,980 million for FY 2025); (ii) the 'No Responsable de IVA' election for small merchants under 3,500 UVT – not advisable for a data-labeling exporter that must recover input VAT; (iii) the zero-rating election for exported services under Statute Article 481 numeral 5 and Decree 2247/1995, which treats certain software, digital, and technical services as exports for VAT purposes when used exclusively abroad; (iv) the optional consolidated corporate tax group election under Law 1819/2016 Article 12 for Colombian groups holding at least 51% of voting shares; and (v) the opt-in to issue 'documento equivalente' invoices for foreign buyers where required. All elections are executed through the MUISCA platform, and the SIMPLE election must be filed with DIAN within the first quarter of the relevant fiscal year.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT – Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA), governed by Tax Statute Articles 420–510, administered by DIAN through MUISCA.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: General threshold: annual gross income exceeding 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 174.3 million for FY 2025) requires compulsory VAT registration under the 'Responsable de IVA' regime. However, a Colombian S.A.S. engaged in exporting AI/BPO services is strongly advised to register from the first day of operations because zero-rated export sales generate recoverable input VAT credits and refund claims that are only available to VAT-registered taxpayers; therefore, the effective registration threshold for this entity is zero (voluntary early registration). There is no monetary threshold for mandatory electronic invoicing: every invoice issued, including export invoices, must be transmitted electronically to DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory 'Facturación Electrónica de Venta (FEV) con Validación Previa' under Resolutions 165/2021 and subsequent technical annexes. Every commercial invoice, credit note, debit note, including export invoices, must be transmitted as XML to DIAN through MUISCA in real time before delivery to the client. DIAN validates the XML and returns an acceptance receipt (acuse) and a unique digital stamping code: CUDE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or CUDS (Código Único de Facturación DIAN). The issuer must connect via an authorized 'proveedor tecnológico' (software vendor) or through its own ERP using approved DIAN web service APIs (SOAP/REST with X.509 digital certificate), and every invoice must include a QR code linking to the MUISCA validation record. Export invoices follow the same real-time clearance procedure; once DIAN validates the invoice, it becomes effective against the client, and the client has five business days to accept or reject it under the 'aceptación' rules. There is no physical stamp requirement; the CUDE/CUDS serves as the official digital stamp for all fiscal purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% VAT rate is available under Statute Article 481 numeral 5 (export of services) and DUR 1625/2016 Article 1.3.1.16.3 when all of the following cumulative conditions are met: (1) the beneficiary/client is a non-resident entity or individual without domicile in Colombia (a permanent establishment of the client in Colombia disqualifies the zero rate); (2) the service is economically used exclusively abroad and has no 'vinculación económica' with Colombian territory; (3) the consideration is paid from abroad and channeled through the Colombian foreign exchange market (including receipts via PayPal/Wise routed through an authorized intermediary with a 'Declaración de Cambio'); and (4) the activity qualifies as a technical, informatics, software-related, or data-processing service – computer vision bounding-box annotation and RLHF data curation fall within this definition when delivered remotely via cloud infrastructure. The exporter must maintain per-client service agreements, geo-location and server-access logs evidencing offshore use, and a documented nexus analysis showing that the AI/ML work product is incorporated abroad and not consumed in Colombia; the zero-rating also requires the exporter to file the annual 'Información Exógena' reporting the export transactions to DIAN.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación de Servicios Form F-103 and, when physical goods are part of the supply, the DIAN export declaration through VUCE; must be linked to the MUISCA-validated export invoice bearing the CUDE/CUDS).

Bill of Lading / Equivalent Delivery Evidence Substitute (for cloud-delivered data-labeling and RLHF services a sea Bill of Lading does not apply; the accepted substitute comprises the signed technical service agreement, IP geo-location logs, SaaS/cloud access logs, time-stamped annotation delivery reports, and the remote-handover certificate demonstrating completion of the services for the non-resident client abroad).

Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Canalización de Divisas issued by the authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary on Form DCIN-4 'Declaración de Cambio por Servicios', evidencing that the export proceeds were received in foreign currency and repatriated into Colombia through the official exchange market within the mandatory deadline).
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Service exports are a high-priority DIAN audit segment given the ease of re-characterizing digital BPO deliverables as domestic taxable services. Consequences of disallowance: (i) the 19% VAT is retroactively clawed back on the entire audited revenue stream, plus default interest under Statute Article 635; (ii) the 'sanción por inexactitud' (Article 648) applies up to 100% of the omitted tax generally and up to 200% in cases of fraudulent documentation, artificial export structures, or gross negligence; (iii) refunds of input VAT ('exceso de IVA') obtained on the strength of invalid zero-rated exports are recoverable retroactively with indexation and accumulated moratory interest; (iv) late or unsettled FX repatriation breaches the Colombian exchange-control regime (Banco de la República Resolución Externa 1 of 2018 and Circular DCIN-83), exposing the S.A.S. to fines up to double the uncollected amount and to DIAN's presumption that the service was actually consumed in Colombia; (v) repeated or deliberate false export certificates trigger criminal liability for fiscal fraud under Penal Code Article 434-A (sentences of 36 to 108 months) and ineligibility of the legal representative; and (vi) the DIAN may also impose per-invoice penalties for e-invoicing non-compliance, including the rejection of export-invoice validity and the loss of the CUDE/CUDS stamp, which invalidates the client's right to rely on the zero rate.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), exercising exchange-control powers under Law 9 of 1991, Law 31 of 1992 (Estatuto Orgánico del Sistema Financiero), and the current compendium of exchange rules contained in Resolución Externa 1 de 2018 of the Banco de la República. The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervises all authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (intermediarios del mercado cambiario) and sanctions exchange-control infractions; DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) cross-validates service-export and service-import declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible under a managed-float regime; there are no exchange licenses or quantitative restrictions on current-account operations, including the export of BPO and AI data-labeling services. All cross-border settlements must be routed through an authorized local intermediary and reported on an electronic Foreign Exchange Declaration (Declaración de Cambio). Profit and capital repatriation to the foreign parent is lawful only if (i) the underlying foreign direct investment (FDI) has been registered with Banco de la República, and (ii) all corporate income-tax and remittance-tax obligations under Estatuto Tributario Art. 408 are settled. FDI prior Central Bank authorization is not required; registration is performed by the local bank at the moment the funds are channeled, or directly with Banco de la República within two (2) months when the contribution is in-kind or non-channeled. The official conversion reference is the Tasa Representativa del Mercado (TRM) published daily by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia does not operate a literal surrender-to-central-bank rule; instead, exporters must canalizar (channel) 100% of export proceeds through an authorized intermediary of the foreign-exchange market and convert the foreign currency into COP. For services exports (ISIC 8220 data-labeling and RLHF curation), the exporter has six (6) months from the date the service is invoiced or otherwise completed to receive, channel, and convert the proceeds; the channeling must be evidenced by the electronic Foreign Exchange Declaration (Formulario 6 — Exportación de Servicios). The term may be extended only by Banco de la República upon reasoned request. Proceeds left in offshore accounts or in third-party platforms (PayPal, Wise) beyond the mandatory channeling term constitute an exchange infraction (infracción cambiaria) subject to SFC sanctions. If the contract is with a U.S. principal in USD, the entity may request a cuenta de compensación (compensation account) authorization under Resolución Externa 1 de 2018 to retain working cash abroad on a revolving basis, with mandatory periodic repatriation and quarterly reporting through the same intermediary.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Depósito COP/USD for FDI) + Operational Current Account (Cuenta Corriente COP)
Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Inversión Extranjera) + Operational Current Account
Operational Current Account + Multi-currency USD clearing account
Operational Current Account + Foreign Investment Escrow Account
Operational Current Account + USD Compensation Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as the primary treasury rail; Medium as a supplementary receivable-collection rail. Payoneer, Wise Business, and PayPal Mass Payout are not licensed Colombian foreign-exchange intermediaries and cannot satisfy the mandatory channeling obligation under Law 9 of 1991. Their use is legally tolerated only as a collection layer for low-value U.S. payouts; the accumulated balances must be withdrawn to an authorized local bank account within the statutory six-month channeling term, at which moment the electronic Foreign Exchange Declaration is filed and COP is credited. If the entity maintains balances or operating revenue offshore beyond the term, the SFC may classify the arrangement as an unauthorized compensation account and levy fines. Decisive mitigation: obtain a Banco de la República cuenta de compensación authorization; otherwise, instruct each Mass PayPal Payout and Wise settlement to funnel directly to Bancolombia or Banco de Bogotá via local clearing (PSE/ACH) with reference to the export invoice and the FX Declaration identifier.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted for a standard non-sanctioned S.A.S. (minimum capital is not required under Colombian law). Directors and beneficial owners do not generally need to travel to Colombia; the legal representative or a person holding a special power of attorney (poder general amplio y suficiente) must appear before the bank compliance officer, either physically at a branch or via a high-assurance video interview with notarized document recognition. The complete dossier comprises: (i) Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation issued by the Cámara de Comercio within 30 days; (ii) RUT (Registro Único Tributario) as the NIT tax ID; (iii) copy of the S.A.S. incorporation deed and bylaws; (iv) minutes of the shareholders assembly appointing the legal representative and opening the account; (v) UBO and PEP declarations for every natural person holding at least 10% or exercising control; (vi) apostilled passport and entity documents with professional Spanish translation where required; (vii) reference letter (carta de referencia) from a correspondent bank; (viii) a 12-month cash-flow and business plan evidencing the data-labeling BPO service model; and (ix) executed sanctions screening waivers. Foreign-language documents may require certification by a sworn translator (traductor oficial) at the bank's request.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: S.A.S. incorporated less than 90 days with a minimal subscribed capital (e.g., COP 1) and an immediate first trade of USD 100,000 or more in service exports to a U.S. AI data-platform principal.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Execution-ready definitive services agreement (ISIC 8220 annotation and RLHF statement of work) with the U.S. principal; a 12-month order forecast and invoicing calendar; a bank reference letter from the U.S. principal; client-side purchase orders; an explanation of the commercial model showing each USD receivable is tied to labor-hour annotations; and the S.A.S. initial accounting records opened before the compliance interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex beneficial-ownership chain with intermediate holding companies in tax-neutral jurisdictions (e.g., a Cayman Islands parent or U.S. Delaware LLC layered above the Colombian entity) that obscures the ultimate AI fund or venture investor.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete organizational chain to the ultimate natural persons or regulated institutional investor; certificate of incumbency and good standing for each holding layer; substance evidence (lease, payroll, local accountants) for each intermediate; a preliminary Colombian transfer-pricing memorandum under E.T. Art. 260-1 demonstrating arm's-length pricing of annotation services; and signed UBO declarations for each natural person.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected payments arrive through Mass PayPal Payout and Wise rather than conventional SWIFT USD credits, creating an unverifiable counterparty trail due to PayPal's omnibus account structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The merchant contracts and payment-agreement onboarding documents with PayPal and Wise; the platform payout reports mapped to each invoice; a written explanation of the omnibus settlement to the bank's AML team; the U.S. client's KYC file; and a CEO attestation that no payment structuring was used to stay below the USD 10,000 reporting threshold.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative news, sanctions list, or PEP screening hit on a foreign principal (e.g., a U.S. private-equity AI fund whose ultimate fund manager is a politically exposed person or appears on secondary sanctions lists).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A professional sanctions screening certificate issued by a compliance-grade vendor (World-Check or Dow Jones) showing the screening date and matching rationale; a negative OFAC assessment concluding the U.S. principal is not a specially designated national; an external counsel legal memorandum on sanctions exposure; and a contractual covenant requiring the principal to maintain compliance with BIS and U.S. export controls applicable to AI training data.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders wire capital exclusively via SWIFT MT103 to the designated tier-1 bank's Nostro account. The message must identify the beneficiary as CO_SAS Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada and state the purpose as 'Capital contribution - subscription of shares' (equity, not a loan, to avoid thin-capitalization rules under E.T. Art. 118-1). The bank will generate the electronic Foreign Exchange Declaration for Inversión Directa Internacional at the exact TRM conversion moment. The FDI registration with Banco de la República is completed through the bank's electronic system at the date of credit; for in-kind or non-channeled contributions, the direct registration must be filed within two (2) months. The registration certificate becomes the legal evidence for future dividend remittance and capital repatriation. If capital is routed through Wise or PayPal rather than SWIFT, the local bank will still register the COP credit, but the compliance file must preserve the full originating-leg payment trace; strict preference is given to SWIFT for any equity subscription exceeding USD 50,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for (i) subcontractor or gig-worker payroll in source markets, (ii) software licensing and cloud costs (AWS/GCP), (iii) legal and accounting fees, and (iv) intra-group management fees; the instruction must cite the underlying invoice and the FX Declaration reference for imports of services (Formulario 7 — Importación de Servicios) where applicable. For capex-intensive GPU or server infrastructure purchases above USD 25,000, open a Commercial Letter of Credit at sight (SWIFT MT700) with the beneficiary's freight and insurance documents. For recurring U.S.-based subscriptions, use the bank's web-SWIFT connection or the authorized cuenta de compensación topology. Intra-group netting with the U.S. principal is permitted only through the mechanism regulated by Banco de la República, which requires prior authorization via the local intermediary; unlicensed netting is an exchange infraction. A Cuenta de Depósito en Moneda Extranjera held at the Colombian bank may be debited directly for payments abroad; conversion to COP is not obligatory for disbursements made outside Colombia.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/COP outright forwards traded with an authorized intermediary at rates referenced to the TRM, deliverable or cash-settled in COP, recorded under the applicable electronic FX declaration for derivative operations
COP/USD non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with offshore counterparties used solely as a hedge for the USD-denominated revenue stream when domestic counterparties cannot match the tenor
USD/COP foreign-exchange swaps (simple exchange of currencies with reversal at maturity) with an authorized bank
Vanilla USD/COP options (call or put) with an SFC-authorized local bank to cap remittance conversion costs
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps where the SAS or the foreign parent carries floating-rate USD liabilities in the United States under an internal financial hedge policy
Central-Bank-registered spot contracts (FX spot with settlement T+0 or T+1) for immediate trade-payable conversion and payroll COP funding

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) of the company's domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year, per Código de Comercio arts. 19 and 33; no extension tied to the NIT last two digits
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal surcharge of approximately 1% of the tariff per month plus fixed municipal penalties; continuous non-renewal for two consecutive years enables the Cámara de Comercio to cancel the mercantil registration (administrative strike-off), resulting in loss of commercial evidence privileges under the SAS limited-liability form.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros Anuales y Acta de Asamblea General de Accionistas (annual financial statements approved by shareholders and deposited at the commercial registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (deposit of certified financial statements and assembly minutes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be prepared within 3 months of the December 31 fiscal year-end (by March 31); shareholders' approval meeting must occur by March 31; certified statements and minutes are deposited with the Cámara de Comercio within one month after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve or deposit accounts blocks completion of the annual renewal; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose pecuniary fines on the legal representative and, in cases of chronic non-compliance, order judicial dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between early August and late October following the fiscal year, per the DIAN resolution calendar keyed to the last two digits of the NIT (e.g., tax year 2024: 9 August – 22 October 2025)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing sanction of 5% per month or fraction of the tax payable, capped at 100%; zero-tax filers incur 0.5% of gross income; moratorium interest accrues at approximately 1.5% per month; persistent default triggers coercive collection, fiscal embargo, and suspension of the RUT tax-clearance status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena Anual (annual third-party and tax-relevant information return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in early March for the preceding tax year (e.g., 7 March 2025 for fiscal year 2024); submitted 100% electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: ET Art. 651: for each inexact or omitted item, 1% of the reported value with a minimum of 10 UVT and a maximum of 15,000 UVT (approximately USD 1,800 to 180,000); progressive fines for late filing; blocking of the paz y salvo tax-clearance certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Industria y Comercio (ICA – municipal industry and commerce tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal finance secretariat (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda de Bogotá or equivalent municipal treasury where the establishment operates)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by April 30 in most major municipalities, subject to local decree; Bogotá applies an April electronic filing window for the preceding year's taxable activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% per month of the tariff payable, capped at 100%, plus moratorium interest; unpaid ICA obligations become public-credit liens, block local paz y salvo certificates, and prevent renewal of municipal operating permits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Actualización Anual de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB (annual UBO/beneficial-owner confirmation to the tax administration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB / UBO module)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually concurrent with the income-tax return window (August–October); any shareholding or control change must also be updated within 20 business days of the relevant transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: ET Art. 651 fines up to 15,000 UVT (approximately USD 170,000) for late, incomplete, or inaccurate final-beneficiary reporting; additional suspension of tax clearance and heightened AML counterparty risk ratings.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Colombian national corporate income tax; no subnational corporate income tax).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: There is no general tax holiday for an S.A.S. data-labeling BPO. Preferential treatment is available only where the company is a certified Free Trade Zone user (20% CIT), or where eligible expenditure for research, technological development, and innovation is claimed under Article 158-1 E.T.; routine data annotation normally does not qualify absent certification. The 'orange economy' exemption no longer reduces the effective rate for this scope.
